title: 2D Stability Selection: Design Jittering to Exclude Correlated Irrelevant Features
abstract: arXiv:2605.02205v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Stability Selection resamples the observations but leaves the design untouched, so it cannot reject an irrelevant feature that is correlated with the relevant ones in a way that violates the irrepresentable condition. Such a feature (a ``confounder'') is selected in a substantial fraction of resamples, and the exchangeability behind the false-positive bound of Stability Selection fails. We propose 2D Stability Selection (2D-SS), which aggregates selection frequencies over half-samples and over a grid of injected design noise, and reduces to Stability Selection at zero noise. Because input noise acts, in expectation, as Tikhonov regularisation, a jittered Lasso fit is a noisy elastic net whose support recovery is governed by a noise-indexed irrepresentable condition. translated_title: 二维稳定性选择：通过设计抖动排除相关的无关特征
translated_abstract: 稳定性选择（Stability Selection）对观测样本进行重抽样，但保持设计矩阵不变，因此无法拒绝那些与真实相关特征相关联、且违反不可表示条件的无关特征。这样的特征（“混淆变量”）会在相当大比例的重抽样中被选中，从而导致稳定性选择假阳性界所依赖的可交换性失效。我们提出二维稳定性选择（2D-SS），该方法在半样本以及注入设计噪声的网格上聚合选择频率，并在零噪声时退化为标准的稳定性选择。由于输入噪声在期望意义上起到Tikhonov正则化的作用，经过抖动的Lasso拟合相当于一个带噪声的弹性网，其支撑恢复由一个以噪声水平为索引的不可表示条件所支配。因此，抖动可以修复混淆变量违反Lasso条件的设计，尽管它也可能带来负面影响。我们给出了违反条件的特征……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出二维稳定性选择（2D-SS），通过在半样本和注入设计噪声的网格上聚合选择频率，能够排除违反不可表示条件的相关混淆特征，从而修复标准稳定性选择无法控制的假阳性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes 2D Stability Selection (2D-SS), which aggregates selection frequencies over half-samples and a grid of injected design noise, enabling the exclusion of correlated confounder features that violate the irrepresentable condition and thereby repairing the false-positive failures of standard Stability Selection.
